readings: Group compliance cases by `brokrepstat`, treating NULL as its own status. Ignore NULL `modelconf` values when calculating averages. Qualify statuses whose average `modelconf` is greater than the average `modelconf` across all cases. For each qualifying status, return the status, its average `modelconf`, that average minus the all-case average, and that average divided by the mean of the qualifying statuses’ averages. Return no rows if either reference average is missing. Do not round.

Group compliance cases by `brokrepstat`, treating NULL as its own status. Ignore NULL `modelconf` values when calculating each status’s average. Qualify statuses whose average `modelconf` is greater than the unweighted mean of all statuses’ non-NULL averages. For each qualifying status, return the status, its average `modelconf`, that average minus the mean of all statuses’ averages, and that average divided by the mean of the qualifying statuses’ averages. Return no rows if either reference mean is missing. Do not round.
queries:
WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
    FROM compliancecase
    GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
all_case_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
    FROM compliancecase
),
qualifying_statuses AS (
    SELECT s.status, s.avg_modelconf, a.avg_modelconf AS all_case_avg
    FROM status_averages AS s
    CROSS JOIN all_case_average AS a
    WHERE s.avg_modelconf > a.avg_modelconf
),
qualifying_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS avg_of_averages
    FROM qualifying_statuses
)
SELECT q.status,
       q.avg_modelconf,
       q.avg_modelconf - q.all_case_avg,
       q.avg_modelconf / qa.avg_of_averages
FROM qualifying_statuses AS q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_average AS qa
WHERE q.all_case_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND qa.avg_of_averages IS NOT NULL

WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
    FROM compliancecase
    GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
all_statuses AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_all
    FROM status_averages
),
qualifying_statuses AS (
    SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf
    FROM status_averages AS s
    CROSS JOIN all_statuses AS a
    WHERE s.avg_modelconf > a.mean_all
),
qualifying_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_qualifying
    FROM qualifying_statuses
)
SELECT
    q.brokrepstat,
    q.avg_modelconf,
    q.avg_modelconf - a.mean_all,
    q.avg_modelconf / m.mean_qualifying
FROM qualifying_statuses AS q
CROSS JOIN all_statuses AS a
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS m
WHERE a.mean_all IS NOT NULL
  AND m.mean_qualifying IS NOT NULL
